scope: Conditional related-Bandido RAM address/data/strobe connections; no transaction timing qualification

manufacturer_functions.LS153: With G_n=0, select B:A=00/01/10/11 chooses C0/C1/C2/C3. A pin14, B pin2; 1Y pin7, 2Y pin9; G_n pins1/15 are grounded in the address muxes.
manufacturer_functions.LS02: Positive NOR. Tied inputs on 3E pins8/9 give output10=NOT HREAD_n; inputs11/12 give output13=NOT(input11 OR input12).
manufacturer_functions.LS32: Positive OR. Negative-input/output AND-style symbols in the schematic do not make the fitted LS32 a positive-logic NAND.

selector_connections.A_pin14: 4D output8 is NOT CP2 COMADR_n pin29; shared by all four RAM muxes.
selector_connections.B_pin2: 3E output10 is NOT CP2 HREAD_n pin31; shared by all four RAM muxes.

address_projection.convention: Treat C0/C2 as row and C1/C3 as column, with CPU byte index row + (column << 7); real RAS/CAS edge ordering is still open.
address_projection.limit: H/V names are physical CP3 levels. Their counter phase, reset, flip polarity and visible coordinate origin are not inferred here.

read_data_path.common_input: 4E/4H common AND input net terminates at +5 V through R4 1k. It is a high input, not a phase control.
read_data_path.function: RD0..RD7 buffer corresponding DO0..DO7 through LS08 gates. Valid DO timing remains a DRAM-cycle question.
read_data_path.correction: Supersedes the earlier assumption of an unqualified common gating waveform in sheriff_memory_primary_connections.json.

strobe_connections.STSTB: CPU 4B LS08 inputs4/5 are CPU SYNC pin19 and inverted CP2 phi1 TTL pin17 through 4D input13/output12. STSTB = SYNC AND NOT phi1_TTL. This is a level equation, not an electrical pulse-width qualification.
strobe_connections.RAMSTB_n: CPU 3F LS00 input1 is STSTB, input2 is buffered A14, output3 is DRAM STSTB / RAMSTB_n. RAMSTB_n = NOT(A14 AND STSTB). It clears readback 4F/4G and READY 3D; MEMR is a separate neighboring status net.
strobe_connections.disable: 3E pin11=CPU WR RD cross-sheet net; pin12=NOT HREAD_n; output13=HREAD_n AND NOT CPU_WR_RD_level.
strobe_connections.CAS_n: 5B LS32 pin1=CP2 CAS_n pin25, pin2=disable, output3 to all 4116 CAS pin15: raw_CAS_n OR disable.
strobe_connections.RAS_n: 5B LS32 pin12=CP2 RAS_n pin27, pin13=disable, output11 to all 4116 RAS pin4: raw_RAS_n OR disable.
strobe_connections.WE_n: First mux 1Y pin7 goes to the shared 4116 write input. C0/C2/C3 are high; C1 pin5 comes from 3F LS00 output6. Its inputs4/5 carry inverted CPU WR_n (4D LS04 output4) and buffered A14. Thus WE_n is NOT(A14 AND NOT CPU_WR_n) during BA=01 and high otherwise. Raw mux/strobe phase and DRAM write-edge ordering remain open.
strobe_connections.write_predicate: At the drawn pin levels: HREAD_n AND NOT COMADR_n AND A14 AND NOT CPU_WR_n. This is a Boolean enable predicate, not the effective DRAM commit edge.

raw_clock_connections.CAS_n: I/O 4A LS164 QB pin4 -> 4B LS04 input3, output4 -> CP2 pin25. raw_CAS_n = NOT 4A_QB.
raw_clock_connections.RAS_n: I/O 4A QB pin4 -> 4F LS00 input5; 4A QD pin6 -> input4; output6 -> 2I LS04 input1, output2 -> CP2 pin27. raw_RAS_n = 4A_QB AND 4A_QD.
raw_clock_connections.COMADR_n: I/O 4A QG pin12 -> 4B LS04 input11, output10 -> CP2 pin29. COMADR_n = NOT 4A_QG; CPU-board inversion makes the LS153 A selector equal 4A_QG.
raw_clock_connections.HREAD_n: I/O 4I QC pin12 through 2I LS04 input5/output6 -> CP2 pin31, consistent with the earlier serializer derivation.
raw_clock_connections.phase_limit: These are connected zero-delay equations at the drawn pins. Complete 4A clock/data and 4I counter initialization/reset order remain to be derived before assigning master ticks or valid-data edges.

limits: Related Bandido connectivity remains conditional for the exact Sheriff revision.
Raw COMADR/HREAD/RAS/CAS clock-network phase and CPU WR RD generation remain open.
Boolean WE qualification is derived; effective DRAM write timing, access/refresh and serializer capture/sample ordering remain open.
No physical delay, full READY response, production RTL, MAME graphics or release pass is asserted.
